questions.questionHtml: A polygon has a perimeter of 16 cm and an area of 16 cm<sup>2</sup> The shape of the polygon is a

options.text: rectangle which is not a square
options.html: rectangle which is not a square

questions.solution:
Given:

Perimeter = 16 cm 

Area = 16 cm2

Detailed solution:

If we assume the shape to be square

Perimeter = 4a 

⇒ 4a = 16

⇒ a = 4 cm

Area = a2

⇒ 4 × 4

⇒ 16 cm2

∵ The square shape satisfy the condition of equal perimeter and area 

∴ The shape of the polygon is square

questions.question: The area of a regular polygon with a side of 8 cm is 112 cm 2 . If the perpendicular distance from the centre to the side of the polygon is 7 cm, then the number of sides of the polygon is:
questions.questionHtml: The area of a regular polygon with a side of 8 cm is 112 cm<sup>2 </sup>. If the perpendicular distance from the centre to the side of the polygon is 7 cm, then the number of sides of the polygon is:
questions.solution:
Given:

The area of a regular polygon = 112 cm2

Side of the polygon = 8 cm

Perpendicular distance from the center to the side (apothem) = 7 cm

Formula used:

Area of a regular polygon = \(\dfrac{1}{2}\)  × Perimeter × Apothem

Perimeter = Number of sides (n) × Side length

Calculation:

112 = \(\dfrac{1}{2}\)  × (n × 8) × 7

⇒ 112 = \(\dfrac{1}{2}\) × 56n

⇒ 112 = 28n

⇒ n = \(\dfrac{112}{28}\)

⇒ n = 4

∴ The correct answer is option (2).

questions.question: A regular polygon with six sides is inscribed in a circle of radius 7 cm. Find the area of the region between the circle and hexagon.
questions.questionHtml: A regular polygon with six sides is inscribed in a circle of radius 7 cm. Find the area of the region between the circle and hexagon.
questions.solution:
Given:

Radius of circle = 7 cm

Formula Used:

Area of hexagon \( = 6 \times \frac{{\sqrt 3 }}{4} \times {\left( {side} \right)^2}\)

Calculation:

Area of the polygon \( = 6 \times \frac{{\sqrt 3 }}{4} \times {7^2}\) = 127.302 cm2

Area of circle = 22/7 × 72 = 154 cm2

⇒ Area of the region between circle and hexagon = Area of circle – Area of hexagon

∴ Area between circle and hexagon = 154 – 127.302 = 26.698 ≈ 26.7

questions.question: Area of any regular polygon is, where n is the side of polygon, a is the length of the side.
questions.questionHtml: Area of any regular polygon is, where n is the side of polygon, a is the length of the side.

options.html: n × (a2/4) × tan (180°/n)
n × (a2/4) × sin (180°/n)
n × (a2/4) × cos (180°/n)

questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

The area of any regular polygon is calculated as 1/2 × Perimeter × Apothem.

For a polygon with n sides of length a, the Perimeter = n × a.

The Apothem (h) is given by: h = (a/2) × cot (180°/n).

⇒ Area = (1/2) × (n × a) × (a/2) × cot (180°/n).

⇒ Area = n × (a2/4) × cot (180°/n).

∴ The correct answer is n × (a2/4) × cot (180°/n) sq. units.

Alternate Method

Given:

Number of sides of the regular polygon = n

Length of each side = a

Formula Used:

Area of a regular polygon = n × Area of one isosceles triangle formed by the center and two adjacent vertices.

Calculations:

⇒ In ΔOAB, let O be the center of the polygon and AB be one side of length a.

⇒ The central angle ∠AOB = 360°/n.

⇒ In right-angled triangle ΔOAM, ∠AOM = (1/2) × ∠AOB = 180°/n.

⇒ AM = MB = a/2.

⇒ In ΔOAM, tan (180°/n) = AM / OM = (a/2) / h.

⇒ h = (a/2) / tan (180°/n) = (a/2) × cot (180°/n).

⇒ Area of ΔOAB = (1/2) × base × height = (1/2) × a × (a/2) × cot (180°/n).

⇒ Area of ΔOAB = (a2/4) × cot (180°/n).

⇒ Total Area of n-sided polygon = n × Area of ΔOAB.

⇒ Area = n × (a2/4) × cot (180°/n).

∴ The correct answer is n × (a2/4) × cot (180°/n) sq. units.

Additional Information

Interior Angle of a Regular Polygon

Each interior angle of a regular polygon with n sides is given by the formula: ((n − 2) × 180°) / n.

Exterior Angle of a Regular Polygon

Each exterior angle of a regular polygon is given by: 360° / n. The sum of all exterior angles is always 360°.

Area in terms of Circumradius

Area can also be expressed using the circumradius (R): Area = (n × R2 / 2) × sin (360°/n).

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of all interior angles of any n-sided polygon is: (n − 2) × 180°.

questions.question: A large regular polygon is made by combining 6 regular hexagons around a common center. What is the ratio of area of the combined shape to one hexagon?
questions.questionHtml: A large regular polygon is made by combining 6 regular hexagons around a common center. What is the ratio of area of the combined shape to one hexagon?
questions.solution:
⇒ Combined area = 6 × Area of one hexagon

⇒ Ratio = (6 × Area of one hexagon) ÷ Area of one hexagon

⇒ Ratio = 6 : 1

questions.question: The area of a regular polygon with a side of 6 cm is 96 cm 2 . If the perpendicular distance from the center to the side of the polygon is 4 cm, find the number of the sides of the regular polygon.
questions.questionHtml: The area of a regular polygon with a side of 6 cm is 96 cm<sup>2</sup>. If the perpendicular distance from the center to the side of the polygon is 4 cm, find the number of the sides of the regular polygon.
questions.solution:
Let the number of sides of polygon be ‘x’

When the vertices of a regular polygon are joined to its center, the n-sided polygon is divided into ‘n’ equal triangles

⇒ Area of polygon = n × Area of a triangle

∵ Area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height

⇒ Area of polygon = n/2 × side of polygon × perpendicular distance from center to side of polygon

Substituting values,

⇒ 96 = n/2 × 6 × 4

⇒ n = 96/12 = 8

∴ No. of sides of regular polygon = 8

questions.question: A right prism with a rectangular base has a perimeter of 28 cm and height 12 cm. What is its lateral surface area?
questions.questionHtml: A right prism with a rectangular base has a perimeter of 28 cm and height 12 cm. What is its lateral surface area?
questions.solution:
Lateral Surface Area (LSA) = Base Perimeter × Height

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = 28 × 12

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = 336 cm2

questions.question: ABCDEF is a regular hexagon of side 2 feet. The area, in square feet, of the rectangle BCEF is:
questions.questionHtml: ABCDEF is a regular hexagon of side 2 feet. The area, in square feet, of the rectangle BCEF is:
questions.solution:
Given:

ABCDEF is a regular hexagon of side 2 feet.

Formula Used:

Each interior angle of a polygon = \(\frac{(n-2) \times 180}{n}\)

Area of rectangle = length × width.

Calculation:

Each interior angle of a polygon = \(\frac{(n-2) \times 180}{n}\)

Each interior angle of a hexagon = \(\frac{(6-2) \times 180}{6}\)

⇒ Each interior angle of a hexagon = 120°

Draw a perpendicular bisector from angle A to opposite BF

Angle A is bisected into 120/2 = two angles pf 60°, so

∠ BAM = 60°

∠ BMA = 90°

∠ ABM = 30°

There are two identical right angle 30°-60°-90° triangles: \(\triangle\)AMB and \(\triangle\)AMF

30-60-90 right triangles have side lengths in the ratio \(x: x\sqrt3:2x\)

side AB, opposite to 90° angle, corresponds with 2x = 2

side AM, opposite to 30° angle, corresponds with x = 1

side BM, opposite to 60° angle, corresponds with \(x\sqrt3 = \sqrt3\)

∴ BM + MF = \(2\sqrt3\)

∴ Area of rectangle = length × width.

⇒ Area of rectangle = 2 × \(2\sqrt3\) = \(4\sqrt3\)
